title: The Unexpected Playlist
author: Freya Halloran
blurb: Lena Dunmore, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
